patch_list: On Android TV, shows a one-time message that future Android TV patches come from the tv-morphe-patches source. It does nothing on a phone.
Blocks the app's analytics and tracking requests (Hulu telemetry, Conviva, and Adobe) through an in-process native hook, with no root. Functional traffic is untouched.

Removes the ads Hulu stitches into its on-demand videos, through an in-process native hook, with no root. It removed the ad breaks from an on-demand episode in testing, but it has not been tested widely and may not remove every ad. It only…
